essence:
The previous vimarśa (the ṣaṣṭha) established the powers — knowledge, memory, removal
(jñāna, smaraṇa, apohana).
The three powers (knowledge, memory, removal) were established in the previous vimarśas.

> This pratibhā (the flashing), seasoned with the order of the various word-objects — the order-less,
> infinite-consciousness-form knower, he is the great Lord.
